description: This file defines the CacheableMetadata class in Drupal, which manages cacheability metadata such as cache tags, contexts, and max age, including methods for merging, applying, and creating metadata objects.

classes.name: CacheableMetadata
classes.description: A class for passing cacheability metadata, implementing methods to get/set cache tags, contexts, max age, and to merge or create metadata objects.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns the cache tags associated with this metadata.

methods.name: setCacheTags
methods.description: Sets the cache tags for this metadata.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns the cache contexts associated with this metadata.

methods.name: setCacheContexts
methods.description: Sets the cache contexts for this metadata.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns the maximum age (in seconds) for cache validity.

methods.name: setCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the maximum age (in seconds) for cache validity.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another CacheableMetadata object into this one, combining cache tags, contexts, and max age.

methods.name: applyTo
methods.description: Applies this cache metadata to a render array.

methods.name: createFromRenderArray
methods.description: Creates a CacheableMetadata object from a render array.

methods.name: createFromObject
methods.description: Creates a CacheableMetadata object from a cacheable dependency object or other.
